name: Lavender Bouquet
source:
As a florist, Lavender has helped many of her customers convey their feelings through flowers. Ironically, she struggles to communicate her own feelings to her boyfriend. Maybe this time, she could receive some help from her customers instead?

[From [url=https://ezmizu.itch.io/lavender-bouquet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名花店，薰衣草帮助她的许多顾客通过鲜花传达了他们的感受。讽刺的是，她很难向男友传达自己的感受。或许这一次，她可以得到顾客的帮助？

[来自[url=https://ezmizu.itch.io/lavender-bouquet]itch.io[/url]]
